comment: Single source of truth for the on-prem nodes. Terraform reads it to build them and Ansible reads it in Module 03 to generate the inventory, so the two can never disagree. Sizing rationale: docs/adr/0004-onprem-substrate.md.

network.name: platform
network.comment: libvirt NAT network. Each node's address is assigned by cloud-init inside the guest and declared here, so nothing is hand-configured and nothing drifts on reboot. The mac field is reserved for a future switch to libvirt DHCP reservations and is unused today.
